name: 94558 · Napa, CA
findings: ZIP 94558 (Napa) has 284 nonprofit organizations. 135 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94558 (Napa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94558 (Napa) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 88 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
